why: Reviewer picks (2026-10-28 03:50 UTC) on the WB hook angles: a no-context premise line, 'Wait, that's Tom Cruise?', the strangest line. Approved scene clips + trailer 2A only. tighten off: the footage's own pauses and music beats stay.

rules: End EVERY caption with #DiggerPartner and tag Warner Bros. (no tag = not paid)
Only footage from the approved DIGGER folder (trailers, TV spots, clips); nothing from outside, no other movies, no old Tom Cruise clips
Footage's own audio only: no added music, no voice-over, no face-cam
Vertical 9:16, 10-60 s, hook in the first 2 s, on-screen text or captions throughout
Framing in your own words: people are split on DIGGER, go see it and decide for yourself
Never reveal or hint at the twist; no spoilers in clip or caption
Never mention Scientology, Tom Cruise's past relationships or past roles; never compare to Don't Look Up; don't politicize
Don't quote review scores or box office numbers, don't argue with critics
No AI changes to anyone's face or voice
At least 40% of views from the US; keep likes visible; keep the post up 30 days; submit on Whop with demographics
